interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about the benefits of travel.
questions: Q1: Can you share a memorable experience from your travels?
Q2: What challenges have you faced while traveling?
Q3: In your opinion, how does travel influence personal growth?
Q4: What advice would you give to someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about the impact of music on our lives.
questions: Q1: How has music played a role in your daily routine?
Q2: What are some challenges you think people face when choosing music?
Q3: Do you believe music can affect our emotions? Why or why not?
Q4: What recommendations do you have for someone looking to explore new music genres?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about reading habits.
questions: Q1: What types of books do you enjoy reading the most?
Q2: Have you ever found it difficult to find time to read? How did you manage?
Q3: Why do you think reading is important in today’s digital age?
Q4: What tips would you give someone who wants to read more regularly?
